test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'COGENT' is written as 'FMJCQR' and 'BRINK' is written as 'EPLLN'. How will 'RANKED' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'COGENT' is written as 'FMJCQR',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44c386d45ea5ab1ac868c7939c8d6c6e0218b01c4c1a5a3aba3f9439b01256ea.png] 

For, 'BRINK' is written as 'EPLLN',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ea6bdf12535be92cbc76c21b8fc970ccb4be61b3738fedde40392bb19137a64.png] 

Similarly, for '**RANKED**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c36fab5c77a214442c32ead4c416b3a4e7cac46c50ed0c9d9be071783e931a4.png] 

So, 'RANKED' will be written as '**UYQIHB**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
